findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context computes a modified config copy but returns the unmodified config
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context, a copy of monitor.config is made and 'schedule_type' is replaced with its display value (lines 160-162), but the returned dict at line 168 uses 'monitor_environment.monitor.config' (the original, unmodified config) instead of the local 'config' variable. The human-readable schedule type is therefore never included in the monitor context emitted with the occurrence. The local 'config' variable is dead code. This was carried over from the old mark_failed module, but since this PR is specifically splitting this logic out, it should be fixed while moving it.

findings.title: Public helper functions (mark_failed_threshold, create_issue_platform_occurrence, get_failure_reason, get_monitor_environment_context, SimpleCheckIn) removed from mark_failed with no compatibility shims
findings.body: This PR deletes mark_failed_threshold, create_issue_platform_occurrence, get_failure_reason, get_monitor_environment_context, HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP, SINGULAR_HUMAN_FAILURE_MAP, and the SimpleCheckIn TypedDict from sentry/monitors/logic/mark_failed.py. Any external code or tests importing these from mark_failed (e.g. tests of failure-reason formatting, or other monitor consumers) will now fail with ImportError. The PR contains no test changes showing these imports were updated repo-wide; verify all call sites/tests were migrated, or add temporary re-exports from mark_failed pointing at the new modules.

findings.title: Refactor moves ~270 lines of incident/occurrence logic with no accompanying tests
findings.body: The PR relocates the entire incident-threshold and occurrence-creation logic into new modules (sentry/monitors/logic/incidents.py and incident_occurrence.py) but adds no tests for the new module boundaries (e.g. try_incident_threshold behavior, create_incident_occurrence, get_failure_reason). If the existing test suite only covers these paths via mark_failed, the module-level contract is untested; adding direct tests for the new public functions would protect the new module boundary that GH-80527 plans to build on.
